title: Neapolitan Margherita Pizza
description: The authentic Neapolitan pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella di bufala, and basil leaves on a perfectly blistered crust.
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil for drizzling
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and salt. Make a well, add yeast mixture and olive oil. Knead 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Preheat oven to maximum temperature (250°C/480°F) with a pizza stone inside.
Crush San Marzano tomatoes by hand. Season with salt.
Stretch dough by hand on a floured surface into a thin 30cm round.
Spread tomato sauce thinly, tear and distribute mozzarella over top.
Slide onto hot pizza stone. Bake 8-10 minutes until crust is blistered and charred.
Remove from oven, scatter fresh basil, drizzle olive oil, and serve immediately.
author: Chef Antonio
